benefits.fund_cash_micros: the fund's cash at the close, null where the set has no fund

earners.at_work: persons at work at the close, after the moves of people who look for work; working owners and unpaid members of a family at work are counted, though they draw no wage
earners.benefits_received_micros: what the fund's programs paid the band's accounts in the period
earners.looking: persons looking for work at the close, counted as jobs_after_moves counts them
earners.money_micros: the band's cash at the close
earners.wages_received_micros: wages the band's accounts were paid in the period

public.hiring_bound_below: hiring bound rows with bound_hours < asked_hours
public.note: every figure is a pair [with a grant, without a grant] over the sites of public provisioning
public.price: [lowest, highest] unit price of their offers at the close in micros, null when none

rules.spare_money_raised: production policies raised above the period's plan

judged_against: the bench's own baseline (bands-baseline.json), never a record of the shipped scenario
labor_cost: The labor of a batch, in the products' costs, is its hours times the wage of the persons employed at the process's sites: the sum of wage times employed persons over the members paid a wage, divided by the sum of those persons, rounded down; a process with none takes the same average over the whole opening. A seeker whose pool pays no wage is offered its place's average wage, found the same way.
leaves_out: The companies' portfolio choice is off: the catalog's company_portfolios is None. Company payouts stay.
No City PD attendance: its inputs come only from a selected City PD intent.
No register checks: the tick's register validates and encodes every family, the bench runs only the engine's own checks.

panel.name: fewest households (40)
panel.rule: the domestic county with the fewest households at the opening (sum over its household rows, households > 0); ties to the lower geoid

panel.name: most employed in farm or extraction (295155)
panel.rule: the domestic county whose Food and Extraction workplaces employ the most people at the opening (staffing members employed, by the workplace's county); ties to the lower geoid
